description: We are a passionate and collaborative team interested in space, science, technology, and innovation. We enjoy solving real-world problems through creative ideas, coding, research, and teamwork.
summary:
FIELDWISE is a decision-support tool that helps farmers plan crop rotations under changing climate conditions. Weather is becoming less predictable, and satellite data is hard to interpret at the farm level. FIELDWISE turns NASA Earth observation data, such as rainfall, temperature and vegetation conditions, into practical guidance.
The farmer selects a field on a map and enters basic details: soil type, current crop, water availability and priorities. FIELDWISE then generates several possible crop rotations and scores each one on water requirement, climate suitability and soil benefit. A what-if feature lets users test how each rotation holds up if rainfall or temperature changes.
Instead of giving one fixed answer, FIELDWISE follows a simple path: Analyze → Compare → Test → Decide. It is built as a web application using Python, JavaScript and open geospatial tools, so it needs no special hardware. It starts with a limited set of crops and one region, with plans to expand later.
